_doc: Declared MCP tools/list size per server: tokens = ceil(bytes/4) of the tools array, tools = count, grouped = exposed as a few dispatcher tools. Written by measure-mcp-sizes.sh --write when the servers are reachable; read by test-claude-sot.sh (budget guard). A stale entry makes the guard wrong, so re-measure when a toolset changes.

cloud-infra-mcp.estimated: grouped build on cloud-u-containers 76a73e9; live service still serves the legacy 167 tools / 20360 tokens until deployed. Re-run measure-mcp-sizes.sh --write after deploy.

cloud-superapp-mcp.estimated: 2-tool build; live still 15 tools / 2913 tokens until deployed. Re-measure after deploy.
